experiment: Distill self-owned Sapling commands into a small batched simultaneous rollout. Compare D1 with eight simulated turns and common random action disturbances using the same leaf and successor model.
training_targets: Actor commands actually issued by our own Sapling-containing candidate, only its physical side. Each board has two seats. Never use examiner actions/weights as policy targets. Raw joint moves only reconstruct past states. Teacher identity intentionally spans existing self models, not the exact current package.
rollout_holdout: Last two listed training_tapes are separate behavioral check only. Remaining six maps fit; require distinct boards, no terminal-response map shared.
native_panel: All 64 already completed tree_response_training paired interventions, eight two-board batches with 8 roots each. Use all six first batches for description and two last batches for a separated four-board check. This is previously studied historical intervention evidence. Input at root is our public observation history and the stored two alternative our joint commands; opponent's actual current/future action and terminal results forbidden as inputs.
comparison: Predict our and opposite moves using the same learned cheap model (assumption). At root both candidates share opponent draw from pre-action board. Each later state recomputes own+enemy orders prior to each joint transition. Common Gumbel perturbations keyed by stream, turn, physical seat and worker UID at tau=.55. Fixed two streams. H=1 and H=8 use the same endpoint score: cash difference plus carried stock discounted by distance to home, no fixed tree bounty or credit for nonexistent sales. A candidate replaces parent only when mean forecast delta>0. A tie selects parent. Raw proceeds and native payoff both reported.
native_gate: For H8 relative to always parent, mean observed final margin delta positive on six discovery batches and four held maps, positive on >=3 of 4 held maps, and better than H1 on mean held return; >=4 unique intervention roots switched on held. If unmet, do not allocate original match. Even a positive observed intervention result does not certify a complete deployed actor. This registered panel only contains planter candidates.
budget: One pinned low-priority CPU2, cheap 18-hidden-unit two-layer per-candidate scoring MLP, 25 epochs, seed 9046, single batch per 384 slots, cap 8 real joint advances / path, no new full native games or formal boards. Historical held scores won't tune search or thresholds.
